# Dr. Lukas Pytlik — Prosthodontist in La Jolla

> Premier prosthodontic care in La Jolla, CA. Dr. Lukas Pytlik, DMD, has been a trusted prosthodontist since 2006, specializing in full-mouth reconstruction, implant restorations, and advanced restorative dentistry. Pioneer of the three-day full-mouth reconstruction technique.

Practice address: 4130 La Jolla Village Dr #204, La Jolla, CA 92037. Phone: (858) 452-8933. New patients seen by appointment; pre-consultation calls available.

## Services

- [Full-Mouth Reconstruction](https://drlukaspytlik.com/full-mouth-reconstruction-rehabilitation-in-la-jolla/): Comprehensive multi-stage restoration including the three-day full-mouth reconstruction technique
- [Dental Implant Restorations](https://drlukaspytlik.com/dental-implant-restorations/): Custom abutments and crowns on osseointegrated implants
- [Premium Dental Crowns](https://drlukaspytlik.com/premium-dental-crowns/): High-strength ceramic crowns for natural aesthetics and durability
- [Premium Dental Bridges](https://drlukaspytlik.com/premium-dental-bridges/): Fixed multi-unit bridges for missing teeth
- [Specialized Prosthodontic Services](https://drlukaspytlik.com/specialized-prosthodontic-services-in-la-jolla/): Complex prosthodontic care, removable and implant-supported prostheses, complete-arch rehabilitation
- [Bruxism & Clenching Solutions](https://drlukaspytlik.com/bruxism-clenching-solutions/): Occlusal splints, bite therapy, and protective restorations
- [Advanced Occlusal Disease Management](https://drlukaspytlik.com/advanced-occlusal-disease-management/): Diagnosis and treatment of bite disorders and occlusal trauma
